answer: Jitter-Fingerprint Admission Gate. Each identity must present a burst-timing profile whose inter-arrival delta matches a hardware-derived schedule within tight tolerance; the gate samples continuously and re-verifies. A crystal clock drift reference anchors the schedule so replay across nodes is detectable. Honest agents cost nothing extra. Attackers pay to emulate unique timing entropy per identity: spoofed jitter needs dedicated timing hardware or harvested clocks, and a shared haven of synchronized traffic collapses the fingerprint, forcing per-identity infrastructure spend.
